El retorno de fase
avanza memoria y no reinicia el estado.
## 2. Regla construida: normalización completa de la fibra de valor
## 3. Primer rango efectivo: primera aparición con h fijo

target.statement: Normalización global de fibras desde cobertura; rango con h fijo sobre historias que publican valores de L[h]; dicotomía cardinal para cada subconjunto ambiente del portador R^L[h]; examen exacto de numerabilidad y cobertura al variar el parámetro. Ninguna candidata cumple aquí las tres condiciones globales de rango. La sección 9 reúne la composición completa en un límite de estados íntegros y prueba R8: recodificación biyectiva con restricciones y operaciones conjugadas. Section 10 proves R9-R13 on the inherited full enriched-history tree: native separated branches; a descending lexicographic chain; a perfect residual kernel still publishing the whole chart; the two strategy implications; and, under ambient Choice, a full-cardinality subset with neither strategy. None is promoted to universal CH.
target.closure_criterion: Val N=Val; N²=N; Nx=Ny iff Valx=Valy. Countable value levels on D_h. Every ambient subset of R^L[h] is countable or equipotent to R^L[h]. Variable-history-code candidates cover ambient values but do not have globally countable levels. R9-R13 retain full histories, use local coverage and contraction, and distinguish a failure of universal game determinacy from a refutation of CH.
target.causal_cutoff_reason: Lecturas y potencias posteriores del continuo conjunto ya heredado; las cinco operaciones permanecen consustanciales y no son reprobadas aquí.

result_maps.statement: Normalización global de fibras desde cobertura; rango con h fijo sobre historias que publican valores de L[h]; dicotomía cardinal para cada subconjunto ambiente del portador R^L[h]; examen exacto de numerabilidad y cobertura al variar el parámetro. Ninguna candidata cumple aquí las tres condiciones globales de rango. La sección 9 reúne la composición completa en un límite de estados íntegros y prueba R8: recodificación biyectiva con restricciones y operaciones conjugadas.
result_maps.map: N selects the least compatible state containing the already-published Val(x), after the HMT generator. lambda_h is first appearance of the rational cut in L_alpha[h] on D_h=Val^-1(R^L[h]). b(x) codes a produced complete history solely to test variable-parameter rank candidates; it is not claimed as a new HMT generation. The H0/H1 candidate has at most two levels and hence an uncountable value level.
result_maps.falsifier: A selected prefix has no compatible successor; equal values give distinct normalizations; a relative rank is asserted on new ambient values without coverage; per-parameter countability is treated as global countability; finite samples are promoted to CH proof.

result_maps.statement: A native binary subtree of complete admissible histories has pairwise separated values.
result_maps.map: Iterate native Out under the inherited exact local interval coverage and uniform contraction; choose two disjoint descendant cylinders at each stage.
result_maps.falsifier: A claimed descendant is not admissible, local interval coverage fails, or two sibling published intervals meet.

result_maps.statement: The lexicographic full-ledger order has an infinite descending chain with distinct published values.
result_maps.map: Relabel each native sibling pair by the finite-code lexicographic order; use x_n=j_X(0^n10^infinity).
result_maps.falsifier: Sibling prefixes are compatible or some distinct x_n have identical values; no inference about every possible HMT order is allowed.

result_maps.statement: The full-history derivative stabilizes at a countable stage and its perfect kernel still publishes the entire nondegenerate interval.
result_maps.map: Iterate the isolated-point derivative on the compact full-history chart; use the countable cylinder basis, closed image and coherent finite reversible symmetries.
result_maps.falsifier: The chart is not compact metrizable, its publication is not a continuous surjection onto a nondegenerate interval, or an allegedly reversible operation is not a homeomorphism.

result_maps.statement: A winning split strategy produces a perfect subset; a winning response strategy implies the target subset is countable.
result_maps.map: Play only native extensions of the full-history tree. Count blocked values at finite positions for a response strategy; use separation for a split strategy.
result_maps.falsifier: Two distinct blocked values occur at one position despite exact local coverage and contraction, or existence of a winning strategy is assumed for arbitrary subsets.

result_maps.statement: Under ambient Choice, there is a full-continuum-cardinality subset with neither strategy in R12; this does not refute CH.
result_maps.map: Enumerate nonempty perfect subsets by an auxiliary ambient well-order; select two fresh points per perfect set. The subset has cardinal continuum and no nonempty perfect subset.
result_maps.falsifier: The perfect-set enumeration misses a set, points are reused, or the auxiliary well-order is falsely attributed to the HMT generator.

conventional_uses.name: Ordinal rank and relative constructibility are posterior classification and proof languages, not selectors of HMT generation.
Transfinite derivative, lexicographic comparison, strategy selection and ambient Choice are posterior proof tools on the already-generated full-history tree.
conventional_uses.scope_note: Selecting a posterior witness subtree is not selection of the HMT generator. The auxiliary well-order in R13 is provided by ambient Choice, not claimed as an HMT-generated well-order.

proof_layers.finite: Exact ternary-reader checks at rational boundaries, equality fibres and separated finite families; not a full TPK execution. No finite execution is claimed to verify the transfinite or arbitrary-subset arguments R9-R13.
proof_layers.compatibility: The selected state at n+1 restricts to that at n; the original enriched history remains unchanged. No unproved extension of the boundary decoder's domain. R8: iota_k rho=widehat-rho iota_(k+1); every typed F:X_k->X_j has widehat-F=iota_j F iota_k^-1. R9 retains native compatible prefixes; R11 applies only coherent reversible finite bijections and their inverse.

limit.finite_levels: Inherited finite surviving state spaces and cylinder intervals in each atlas chart
limit.limit_object: Normalized histories and value quotient of the common generated continuum; native full-history witness trees, invariant perfect kernel and strategy tests
limit.proof: R1-R2 use finite successor coverage and contraction. R3 restricts first appearance to D_h. R4 handles ambient subsets of R^L[h] by considering whether omega1^L[h] is countable in V or equals omega1^V. R5 gives the countable-union obstruction. R6-R7 test variable history codes without claiming an ordinal compression. R8 proves the two coordinatewise inverse maps between the entire state inverse limit and its compatible finite-code inverse limit. It is a lossless change of representation, not a new generator or an ordinal ranking proof. Section 10 proves R9-R13 on the inherited full enriched-history tree: native separated branches; a descending lexicographic chain; a perfect residual kernel still publishing the whole chart; the two strategy implications; and, under ambient Choice, a full-cardinality subset with neither strategy. None is promoted to universal CH.

proof_layers.recognition: R4 includes external subsets of the old-value carrier. It does not identify that carrier with the entire ambient continuum and does not prove ambient CH. R13 is not an intermediate-cardinality set and cannot imply non-CH.

residual_if_any: No rank constructed in this note simultaneously has countable value levels and coverage of every ambient value. The unresolved target concerns values outside R^L[h], not external subsets composed only of old values. The three full-tree candidates in section 10 also do not produce the required global rank; their explicit scope does not imply a general impossibility result about HMT.
global_falsifier: A selected prefix has no compatible successor; equal values give distinct normalizations; a relative rank is asserted on new ambient values without coverage; per-parameter countability is treated as global countability; finite samples are promoted to CH proof.
receipt_purpose: Focal source trace and causal-role control, not a universal proof check, not acceptance of a PDF edition.
